[[File:Aviansie icon.png|left]]
'''Aviansie''' are avian monsters found in both the [[God Wars Dungeon]] and [[Wilderness God Wars Dungeon]]. Like other creatures within the dungeon, they can be found fighting for their god [[Armadyl]], engaging in combat against the followers of [[Zamorak]].

The ability to be assigned aviansie can be purchased for 80 [[slayer reward point]]s with the Watch the birdie slayer reward. Once unlocked, they can be toggled off. Though, in order to toggle them back on, they must be purchased again for 80 slayer points or removed from the assignments list through the use of the block slots.

Aviansie have a mechanic shared with the other Armadylean followers in the dungeon, where even if they are in combat with another monster, if the player attempts to attack them, the aviansie will start attacking the player immediately.

As they are airborne, they are immune to being directly targeted by [[melee]] attacks except for [[salamander]]s and [[halberd]]s. They can be targeted by [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]] attacks. If the player attempts to attack an aviansie with a [[melee weapon]], except for a [[salamander]] or a [[halberd]], the message ''The Aviansie is flying too high for you to attack using melee.'' will appear in their chatbox, and the aviansie will become [[aggressive]] and start attacking the player if it hasn't already. A lone exception to this rule is indirectly attacking the aviansie through weapons such as the [[scythe of Vitur]] or the special attack of [[dinh's bulwark]] on a primary target, provided that the aviansie is in range to be hit first. 

Aviansie are known for their frequent [[adamantite bar]] drops. The aviansie in the God Wars Dungeon will drop them unnoted unless the player has completed the [[Fremennik Diary#Hard|Hard Fremennik tasks]], whereas those in the Wilderness drop them noted. The latter is much more dangerous however due to the risk of player killers, and these aviansie do not drop [[looting bag]]s despite being in the Wilderness.

==Trivia==
* Avian means "of or relating to birds".
* Stat-wise, lower-levelled female aviansie have a lower Defence level than their male counterparts, but the moderate and high-level ones possess a greater Defence and Ranged level than their corresponding variant.
